strengths: One gate per render: sheetMode builds every visibility and editability answer once (sheet-mode.mjs:41-123) and every step reads it through SHEET_STEPS, so the dead/Monokuma/NPC/Spectator/viewer splits are in one table, not in 27 functions.

Each sheet step runs in its own try and a failed one is named to the primary GM once (sheet.mjs:151-198, requirements.mjs announceSheetSteps): one broken Daggerheart selector no longer takes the Calls or the Actions tab with it.

The flicker repair decides from the render's own arguments, not from a mark laid before the write (sheet-repaint.mjs:138-185), and fails to a render on any shape it does not know; a tile in flight is never replaced (refreshPricedTiles 269-281) and a Call window raises its twin rather than opening a second (sheet-actions.mjs:806-813).

A viewer is drawn no pip tooltip, no armed-Call stack and no budget hover at all (sheet-header.mjs:487-546), and the redaction strips the same again (anonymity.mjs redactValues) - nothing GM-only is left to CSS; the GM-only 'Really:' badge is gated on the mode's realBullets / game.user.isGM in both places that draw it (sheet-inventory.mjs:880, sheet-item.mjs:268).

Sanity that a viewer may not read is emptied, not hidden, on every sheet whether or not anonymity is enforced, slots removed because their count is the maximum (sheet-sidebar.mjs:218-237); the Party sheet does the same (415-448).

Typed backstory survives a render (held on the app with selection and focus), saves once on focusout, tab change or close, and refuses to write over another browser's newer text with one warning (sheet-sidebar.mjs:999-1161).

Every row control on the inventory is fronted by one capture-phase guard that drops a row whose item is gone and re-renders (sheet-sidebar.mjs:471-485), so a silent theft never leaves seven dead buttons.

Player-supplied strings (Ultimate, rule text, item names, room names) go through textContent or escapeHTML everywhere they are drawn; flag values printed into class attributes go through classSafe (sheet-item.mjs:351-353).

The GMs' audit judges every player write in one queue per student, records the writer Foundry named, posts its cards to the GMs only (whisperToGms) and decides Undo/Keep once on the primary with the row marked before any write (sheet-audit.mjs:2537-2583, 2856-2884), so two GMs' clicks write once.

Old UI-13 (two sheet sizes in two files) is closed: SHEET_SIZE in config.mjs:525 is read by sheet-fit.mjs:395 and window-scale.mjs. Old UI-15 (the invisible soft hyphen) is closed: sheet-fit.mjs:167 writes it as \u00AD. Old UI-14 is closed for the tile fitter (sheet.mjs:87-95), though the trait row's newer observer repeats its shape (finding 5).

findings.title: A priced tile the student cannot pay for says 'free' on its face: Analyze reads 'free' every time the actions run out outside a trial
findings.where: scripts/sheet-actions.mjs:1545-1552 (costLabelFor), 1219-1220 and 1369-1371 (actionButton); scripts/price.mjs:155-175 (quotePrice's nothingLeft); scripts/config.mjs:1462-1469 (analyze's chain, one step outside the Class Trial)
findings.what_happens: For a key of PRICE_CHAINS (objection, analyze, tamper) the tile's cost line is costLabelFor, which answers DRPG.Action.costFree ('free' / 'za darmo') whenever the quote is blocked. A blocked quote is the one with nothing left to pay with. Outside the Class Trial Analyze's chain is a single action step (stepsBeyondFirst: 'classTrial'), so a student who has spent both actions has a blocked Analyze quote: the tile is dimmed (affordable = !priced.blocked) and its tooltip says 'No action left, so there is nothing to pay for Analyze with.', while the cost line on the tile's face says 'free'. Tamper does the same with no action and a full Sanity track, and Analyze in a trial with no action, no Hope and no Sanity. The stripe meanwhile keeps the ordinary 'action' or 'gm' colour (stripeKindFor's fallback), so the tile is the only one in the grid whose price line contradicts its stripe and its hover.
findings.failure_scenario: A player spends both actions in the afternoon and looks at the grid: the other tiles are greyed under their price, and Analyze, greyed too, reads 'free' - they press it expecting a free analysis and are told there is nothing to pay with.
findings.expected: A blocked tile's face says the price it would cost (the first step, '1 action') or nothing, never 'free'; the tooltip already carries the refusal.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for a test that pins the 'free' label on a blocked quote: R48 (tests-tier0.mjs:3121-3165) only asserts costLabelFor contains priceLabel( and that the tooltip carries priced?.blocked; no test reads the face of a blocked tile. Checked that a blocked quote can reach a drawn tile: the noPrice floor (dead, Monocub, Monokuma) draws no grid (sheetMode actions), but nothingLeft is an ordinary state and Analyze is in ACTION_GRID (config.mjs:1945). git log -S on the two lines finds only a merge of 14.10.2026 (32fd204f) and the gate record after it, so no stage paper records 'free' as the intended wording.

findings.title: On a player's browser the Tamper tile's cached answer is never forgotten when the GMs' ledger changes: the listener that should forget it hears a key only a GM's browser writes
findings.where: scripts/sheet.mjs:99-125 (the clientSettingChanged listener on SETTINGS.remnantSecrets); scripts/sheet-actions.mjs:1068-1161 (tamperAnswers, tamperKey, tamperBlock, askTamper); scripts/settings.mjs:375 and scripts/gm-stores.mjs:111-113 (the key is the GMs' store 'gmRemnants', no player copy)
findings.what_happens: tamperBlock caches 'nothing of yours here' / 'only Reinforced' per actor under the key room|timeOfDay|day|session, and the only other way out of the cache is forgetTamper, called when clientSettingChanged names remnantSecrets. That key is the GMs' Remnant store, written on GMs' browsers alone and with no player copy, so on a player's browser the listener never fires: a trace of the player's laid, erased or swept in the same room and time of day leaves the tile as it was cached. The tile is struck through only when both branches are shut (no erasable trace of theirs and no framing candidate, framingCandidates being every other living student, cleanup.mjs:1591-1596), so the visible case is narrow: a cast down to two.
findings.failure_scenario: With two students left, the killer's player opens their sheet in the kitchen (Tamper struck: 'You know of no Remnant in this room'), Searches there and leaves a trace, and the Tamper tile stays struck through with the same sentence until they change room or the hour turns.
findings.expected: The cache is dropped on the player's browser when something it depends on changes there (a trace this player placed, the clock, a re-render after an own action), or the struck state is not cached across the player's own actions.
findings.refutation_tried: Searched scripts/ for any other caller of forgetTamper or writer of tamperAnswers (none; only sheet.mjs:124 and sheet-actions.mjs:1085, 1152) and for a player copy of the Remnant store or a hook fired on it (remnants.mjs fires none; gm-stores.mjs has no copy row for 'remnants'). The tile stays pressable (roomBlockFor's note, 956-961), so this is advice gone stale, not a refusal.

findings.title: A Spectator's sheet draws no Stop, and the sheet's own comment still says the Stop is present for everyone
findings.where: scripts/sheet-mode.mjs:81 (safeword: !monokuma && !spectator); scripts/sheet-sidebar.mjs:903-915 (injectSafeword); scripts/safeword.mjs:420-436 (the keybinding, editable [] at 431)
findings.what_happens: Since E92 C5 a Spectator's sheet, like a Monokuma's, draws no safeword button; the remaining doors are a keybinding that ships unbound and game.drpg.safeword() in the console. safeword.mjs promises the Stop to 'anyone ... spectator', and injectSafeword's doc comment says 'Present for everyone'. This is old COMM-11, already rated 'partly' by old-1.2.42-comms.json; it is repeated here because the sheet's own text now contradicts its gate.
findings.evidence:
sheet-mode.mjs:81  safeword: !monokuma && !spectator,
sheet-sidebar.mjs:903  * Present for everyone - a Monokuma's player is at the same table, and a
sheet-sidebar.mjs:915  if (mode && !mode.safeword) return;
safeword.mjs:431  editable: [],
findings.failure_scenario: A friend watching as a Spectator is upset by a scene and looks for the Stop on their own sheet, where every player has it; there is none, and no key is bound.
findings.expected: Either the Spectator's sheet keeps the Stop (it is a person at the table, not a student), or the comment and safeword.mjs's promise say who has no on-screen door.
findings.refutation_tried: R3857 (tests-tier1.mjs:58486-58500) pins 'no Stop' under 'the owner's E92 goal (5)'; docs/dev/e92/STATUS.md says nothing of the safeword, so whether the owner chose the Stop's removal in those words is not established (as old-1.2.42-comms.json noted). Searched the HUD, voice tile, spectator line and messenger for another Stop control: none.

findings.title: The trait row's ResizeObserver is not disconnected when the sheet closes (UI-14's shape, again)
findings.where: scripts/sheet-header.mjs:146-185 (fitTraitRow keeps app._drpgTraitFit); scripts/sheet.mjs:87-95 (closeCharacterSheet disconnects only app._drpgTileFit)
findings.what_happens: fitTraitRow makes a new ResizeObserver on every render and disconnects the previous one from app._drpgTraitFit, but the close hook that fixed UI-14 disconnects only the tile fitter's. A closed sheet keeps an observer on its detached row (and the row alive) until that sheet is rendered again; a sheet never reopened keeps it for the session. Each render also adds a document.fonts.ready.then that runs the six-step measure a second time once fonts are ready (already ready after the first load), so every render measures the row twice.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM who opens and closes thirty student sheets in a session holds thirty detached header rows and their observers; nothing visible goes wrong.
findings.expected: The close hook disconnects _drpgTraitFit as it does _drpgTileFit.
findings.refutation_tried: Searched scripts/ for _drpgTraitFit: written and disconnected only in sheet-header.mjs:179-183. The leak is one observer per app, bounded by the actors opened; no frame cost was measured.

perf_shape: Every render of a student's sheet builds ten tiles, each asking roomBlockFor (locateActor, SearchTokens, neighbouringRooms, othersInRoom twice) and a price quote, plus fitActionTiles' and fitTraitRow's forced layouts (up to seven measure steps, twice once fonts are ready) - counts of work read off the source, not measured.

sheet-audit.mjs rollCovering (1926-1942) and callsCover's find (2012-2027) walk the whole chat log newest to oldest and `continue` past messages older than the window instead of stopping; the per-message test is cheap, so this is a shape, not a measured cost.

dead_controls: The flagged write's card (sheet-audit.mjs:2942-2948) and the away card's row buttons (3218-3227) remove their buttons before asking the primary; a refused or unanswered ask leaves the card with no buttons until it is drawn again, the bridge's toast the only word.
The Monocub panel's Bribe Accept / Refuse (sheet-actions.mjs:384-388) disable themselves and never re-enable or read the answer; a refusal leaves both greyed until a render.
The 'the way is shut' label of Known passages is drawn at render from where the token stood (sheet-sidebar.mjs:624-630) and nothing redraws the list on a token's move (its own note, 667-674).
stale_windows: The Mastermind's lair line (sheet-sidebar.mjs:800-827) reads the room's lock off region flags (movement.mjs isLocked) and is redrawn only by its own press's render; a GM's lock in Room Setup or a breach changes the regions, which renders no actor sheet, so the line keeps 'open' and a Lock that asks lock:true again.
The Tamper tile's cached struck-through state on a player's browser (finding 3).

The Monocub panel's purse, Bribe, Bounty and Ghost Bet lines (sheet-actions.mjs:354-393) read the owner's copy; whether a copy change redraws the sheet was not traced in this lane (no row for it in registerSheetTweaks; timed effects have one, settings.mjs:2343-2357).
for_the_security_lane: sheet-audit.mjs was read whole for leaks and flows; its cards go to whisperToGms only and the writer is told one coded line. The arithmetic of the credit and of hopeLeft was not re-derived here.

not_established.what: Whether an Ultimate being typed survives a render of the sheet. The field is a contenteditable span committed on blur (sheet-header.mjs:841-910); unlike the backstory (sheet-sidebar.mjs:1099-1128) nothing holds its typed text or focus across a render, and a render that replaces .character-details either drops the text (no blur on removal) or saves the half-typed text (blur on removal) and drops the focus. Which one Chromium does in Foundry's render is not read.
not_established.live: new live check: Ultimate typed while the GM writes a non-repaintable field

l1.what: What happens to an Ultimate half typed when the sheet renders under the typist
recipe: Open a student's sheet on the player's browser and click the Ultimate line
Type 'Brilliant ch' and leave the caret in the field
On the GM's browser change that student's actions (a pip on the header) or give an item, so the sheet renders (not a Hope write, which repaints)
On the player's browser read the Ultimate line and whether it still has focus, then read actor.getFlag('danganronpa-rpg','ultimate') in the console
l1.settles_if: the typed text and the focus are still there -> no finding; the text is gone, or the flag holds 'Brilliant ch' and the focus is lost -> a minor ux finding (the backstory's hold applied to the Ultimate)

not_established.what: The cost of one student sheet render at a table: ten tiles each locating the actor and quoting a price, two layout fitters, and clock.refreshSheets rendering every open sheet on each clock, timed-effect or passage-copy change (redrawPassageSheets on a GM renders every open student sheet). Counts read off the source only.

l1.what: Frame time and work of a sheet render
recipe: Open three student sheets on the GM's browser
Run await game.drpg.fps({ toChat: false }) while another browser moves the clock one time of day
Read the frames over 33 ms and the clock.refreshSheets.rendered counter in the report
l1.settles_if: no frame over 50 ms on the clock change -> no finding; frames over 50 ms attributed to the sheet pass -> a perf finding

not_established.what: Whether the repaint path is taken at a table at all (renderContext 'updateActor' and renderData as v14 hands them): if not, every Hope, Health and Sanity write renders the sheet, which is the safe failure, and the repaint code is dead there.

l1.what: Whether a resource write repaints or renders
recipe: Open a student's sheet on the owner's and the GM's browsers
From the GM's console write one Hope on that student
Read game.drpg.counters() for a sheet render on both browsers, or watch the Inventory tab's scroll stay put
l1.settles_if: no render on either -> the repaint holds; a render -> the repaint is not reached on v14
